title: Weeknote #2022
summary: A whole lot of links including some food themed stationery
content:
X is bad. Obviously.

Davey hits the nail on the head here:

People return to X just want followers in the strictest sense of the word. Sycophants that will just click like and subscribe on their posts without calling them out on anything. Much like the companies they cover, they just want to see number go up.

Couple of interesting game projects. The first, PS2 games in the browser with WebAssembly. Secondly, someone ported a bunch of N64 games to Miyoo Mini and a there was asecond project just for Mario Kart released around the same time. I'm going to have some fun with these.

This video about sketching was interesting even if it is trying to sell a course which, as best I can tell, everyone doing art on YouTube is.

CMFs new speakers look great — I'm sad I have no use for such a thing.

Converse have a new Hello Kitty range and I want them all.

Donald Faison jumped did an impromptu rendition of "Everything comes down to poo" in this interview.

Matt of Unch fame wrote up the financials for a year of running a cryptic crossword magazine (of which I've bought each issue even though I do not enjoy such things I've since learnt). Postage to anywhere outside the UK as usual becomes the most expensive thing to handle.

A 1692 guide to colour. This is cool.

I was looking at buying another pink AL Star (I did of course, vibrant pink to be specific) but I wanted to see how the colour compared to the other pink Safaris and AL Stars I had. This comparison was the most complete list I could find.

Two HTML boilerplate posts to keep for reference — one from Vale and one from Manuel.

Ioskeley Mono is a "monospace font crafted to match Berkeley Mono's aesthetic. Built by configuring Iosevka". I've switched to this everywhere I can.

Bunny have updated their CLI for better deployments of static sites. Nice.

Tiny Little Office is the kind of stuff we need more. No logins, no bullshit.

These pencil cases by Yup! are incredible and I want them all.
